meta.name: outbound-analyst
meta.description: Analyze and benchmark outbound campaign performance against real lemlist data from 244K+ campaigns and 249M+ emails. Use when asked "are my stats good", "is my reply rate good", "why am I not getting replies", "is my open rate normal", "how do I compare to benchmarks", "my campaign is underperforming", "what's a good reply rate", "is X% good for cold email", "my LinkedIn acceptance rate is low", "how many emails should I send per day", "my deliverability is bad", "analyze my campaign stats", or any question involving outreach metrics, rates, or performance. Always use this skill before giving any opinion on whether a stat is good or bad. This skill gives instant verdicts with real data — not vague "it depends" answers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将外展活动数据与行业基准对比分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做冷邮件或LinkedIn外展，想知道数据是否达标。
copy.tagline_en: Compare your outreach stats against real industry benchmarks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run cold email or LinkedIn campaigns and want to know if your metrics are good.

howto.what: 对用户提供的外展统计数据（如回复率、打开率、接受率等），基于244K+活动、249M+邮件的真实基准即时评判好坏，解释根本原因，并给出1-2个具体改进建议。
howto.when: 当用户询问‘我的数据好吗’、‘回复率正常吗’等类似问题，或任何涉及外展指标、比率、表现的问题时触发。在给出任何统计好坏意见前会自动调用。

say.text: 我的冷邮件回复率是3.5%，算好吗？
say.note: Claude会给出好坏判断和基准对比。

say.text: 领英连接接受率只有20%，怎么提高？
say.note: Claude会分析原因并给出改进方法。

say.text: 帮我全面分析：打开率30%，回复率2%。

howto.what_en: Analyzes user-provided outreach stats (e.g., reply rate, open rate) against real benchmarks from 244K+ campaigns and 249M+ emails, delivers a clear verdict (bad/average/good/exceptional), explains root cause, and gives 1-2 concrete fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks 'are my stats good', 'is my reply rate good', or any question about outreach metrics, rates, or performance. Always used before giving any opinion on whether a stat is good or bad.

say_en.text: My cold email reply rate is 3.5%. Is that good?
say_en.note: Claude will give a verdict with benchmarks.

say_en.text: My LinkedIn acceptance rate is 20%. How to improve?
say_en.note: Claude identifies root cause and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Analyze my campaign: open rate 30%, reply rate 2%.
say_en.note: Claude audits by priority: deliverability, reply rate, etc.
